members.title: Deleting parse_optional_int breaks a test module that still imports it
members.problem: This diff deletes `parse_optional_int` from `_filter_overrides.py`, which is part of the module's public surface. `tests/test_filter_overrides.py` still imports it (line 13) and tests it at lines 155-170. The import fails with ImportError when pytest collects the file, so the whole module stops running, including the unrelated `merge_overrides` and `parse_csv_list` tests in it. The Phase 7 plan (07-01-PLAN.md:33) also lists it as a declared export.

findings.title: parse_optional_int removed from _filter_overrides.py but still imported by tests
findings.problem: The diff deletes `parse_optional_int` from `src/roonseek/web/_filter_overrides.py` (it is no longer defined anywhere, and `library.py`'s inlined int-parsing in `_overrides_from_form` now uses plain `int(raw)` instead). `tests/test_filter_overrides.py` line 7-14 still imports `parse_optional_int` from that module, and three tests (lines 155-170) call it directly.
findings.current_code:
from roonseek.web._filter_overrides import (
    ALLOWED_OVERRIDE_KEYS,
    INT_KEYS,
    LIST_KEYS,
    merge_overrides,
    parse_csv_list,
    parse_optional_int,
)
findings.fix_hint: Remove the parse_optional_int import and its 3 associated tests from tests/test_filter_overrides.py as part of this refactor, since the helper no longer exists.
findings.why_it_matters: This import will raise ImportError at collection time, failing the entire tests/test_filter_overrides.py module (not just the 3 tests targeting the removed function) the moment this diff lands, breaking CI/local test runs.
